---
title: "How to Contribute"
description: "Suggest a paper, join the Zotero group, write for Commentary or report an error."
---

## Suggest a Paper for the Library

Send the title or the DOI of a work on populism, with one line on why it belongs in the [Library](../library/index.qmd), to the editor: editor@populiverse.com

## Join the Zotero Group

The Library lives in a public Zotero group, "PopuliVerse Library". Scholars who suggest papers regularly are invited to join it as editors.

## Write for Commentary

Commentary publishes pieces of 500 to 1,500 words by PhD holders and doctoral candidates. See the [call, the guidelines and the submission form](../commentary/index.qmd#call-for-commentary).

## Report an Error or Ask for a Reply

If something published here is wrong, write to the editor. Corrections are made in the open, never silently. A person or party discussed in an issue may ask for a short reply. Both are set out in the [editorial policy](editorial-policy.qmd).

## Contact

Write to the editor: editor@populiverse.com
